evaluation_procedure_001.answer: yes, reference only to Article II, Section G of the CBA, with specific mention of the Classroom Teachers Assessment System (CTAS) / Competency Assessment and Accomplished Educators Assessment (AEA)
evaluation_procedure_001.evidence: Teachers assigned to the School are subject to a modified and higher order Teacher Evaluation system that will be primarily based on the negotiated "Competency Assessment" process of the adopted Classroom Teachers Assessment System (CTAS); however, during the first 90 days teachers will not be evaluated under the "Accomplished Educators Assessment (AEA)" process.

evaluation_system_002.answer: Classroom Teachers Assessment System (CTAS) / Competency Assessment process; Accomplished Educators Assessment (AEA) after first 90 days
evaluation_system_002.evidence: adopted Classroom Teachers Assessment System (CTAS) ... Accomplished Educators Assessment (AEA)

evaluation_ratings_005.evidence: consecutive annual evaluation performance ratings of unsatisfactory... consecutive annual performance ratings of needs improvement or a combination of needs improvement and unsatisfactory
